line: That bright screen tells your brain
so sleep comes late and shallow.
is still in your blood at midnight,
Your friend swears coffee never keeps him up.
You stay up late on Saturday,
and on Monday your body clock is lost.
It's like flying to another country every week.
Your brain needs a pattern, not a lucky night.
Same wake up time, every single day.
Phone off one hour before bed.
Here's the strange part: being tired is a habit,
Most people quit after two days.
You might wake up and actually feel awake.
